manuscript_role: E13 — Fair-N with one recipe change reverted: the backbone learning rate set back to the shipped value (1e-5); one seed, descriptive.
score_semantics: Raw fake-class logit, mean-pooled over the sampled frames of a face track; a video's score is the maximum over its tracks (see `tracks`; the build checks this for every video). AUC is rank-based.
